correctness.rationale: For all n≥3, terminal equal signs imply all κ≤n-2 switching branch indices are interior and every row image contains them. Each branch slope magnitude n−w_j gives exact Markov P_jk=M_jk/(n−w_j); the claimed positive π solves all stationary balance equations including endpoint deficits A and B. Strong lumpability by w∈{0,1} gives Q rows (1−κ/n,κ/n) and (1−κ/(n−1),κ/(n−1)), stationary p=κ(n−1)/[n(n−1)−κ], eigenvalue λ=κ/[n(n−1)], hence exact covariance, finite-state CLT and variance. Physical entropy is weighted log(n−w), while Parry uniqueness strictly separates it from topological entropy for κ>0, and expansion gives θ(1−θ)/2 at n^−2 scale. Independent rational reconstruction verified 252 words n=3..8, not a proof of all n.
